label: From scratch: new signals, 512 / 256 net, plain and smart phases
description: A brand new model trained from random games, to see whether it can beat evolution-1. Adds five new inputs (my attack map, last stack under threat, safe captures, pieces and tallest stack per kind, stacking moves), a 512-wide first layer and a 256-wide second layer, and the plain / smart phases of evolution-8 to 10 (cap of 10).
